title: Repairing the Trustworthiness of Distilled Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.34831v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Knowledge distillation enables the deployment of large language models through smaller student models, but the compression process can introduce regressions in trustworthiness even when downstream performance is preserved. Repairing such failures is challenging because the original distillation corpus is often unavailable, while direct preference optimization may alter capabilities inherited from the teacher. We propose a targeted repair framework based on the proximal Bregman response function (PBRF) that addresses both limitations. We estimate the curvature required for PBRF using a surrogate proxy dataset, removing dependence on the original transfer corpus, and extend the framework to preference-based supervision through an odds-ratio objective. translated_title: 修复蒸馏语言模型的可信性
translated_abstract: 知识蒸馏使得大型语言模型能够通过较小的学生模型进行部署，但压缩过程即使在下游性能得以保持的情况下，也可能引入可信性方面的退化。修复这类失败具有挑战性，因为原始蒸馏语料库通常不可用，而直接偏好优化可能会改变从教师模型继承的能力。我们提出了一种基于近端Bregman响应函数（PBRF）的针对性修复框架，以解决这两个限制。我们使用替代代理数据集来估计PBRF所需的曲率，从而消除对原始迁移语料库的依赖，并通过比值比目标将框架扩展到基于偏好的监督。这使得可以使用偏好和不偏好响应对，同时约束对蒸馏模型的更改。我们的结果表明，所提出的方法能够改善目标可信性
tldr: 提出基于近端Bregman响应函数（PBRF）的针对性修复框架，无需原始蒸馏语料库即可修复蒸馏语言模型的可信性退化，并通过比值比目标扩展至偏好监督，同时约束模型能力的变化。
en_tdlr: Proposes a targeted repair framework based on the proximal Bregman response function (PBRF) that fixes trustworthiness regressions in distilled language models without requiring the original distillation corpus, and extends to preference-based supervision via an odds-ratio objective while constraining changes to inherited capabilities.
